segments.name: U.S. Gas Utility Services
segments.description: Provides maintenance, replacement, repair and installation services for local natural gas distribution utilities modernizing infrastructure throughout the United States.
segments.evidence: U.S. Gas provides comprehensive services, including maintenance, replacement, repair, and installation for local natural gas distribution utilities ("LDCs") focused on the modernization of customers' infrastructure throughout the United States.

segments.name: Canadian Utility Services
products: construction of electrical systems used in renewable energy projects
segments.description: Provides maintenance, replacement, repair and installation services for local gas and electric utilities and energy providers in Canada, plus storm response.
segments.evidence: Canadian Operations provides comprehensive services, including maintenance, replacement, repair, and installation for local gas and electric utilities and energy providers.

segments.name: Union Electric Utility Services
products: civil, mechanical, electrical, and fabrication (component assembly)
segments.description: Provides electric utility maintenance, replacement, repair, upgrade and expansion services for urban transmission and local distribution infrastructure in union markets.
segments.evidence: Union Electric provides a comprehensive set of electric utility services encompassing maintenance, replacement, repair, upgrade, and expansion services for urban transmission and local distribution infrastructure within union markets.

segments.name: Non-Union Electric Utility Services
segments.description: Provides electric utility maintenance, replacement, repair, upgrade and expansion services for urban transmission and local distribution infrastructure in non-union markets.
segments.evidence: Non-Union Electric provides a comprehensive set of electric utility services encompassing maintenance, replacement, repair, upgrade and expansion services for urban transmission and local distribution infrastructure within non-union markets.

revenueModel.text: Regulated electric and gas utilities pay Centuri under long-term master service agreements and bid contracts for modernizing, maintaining and installing their distribution and transmission infrastructure.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our customer relationships are governed by long-term master service agreements ("MSAs"), comprising approximately 78% of our total revenue during fiscal 2025.

changes.text: In 2025 the company renamed the segment previously known as Canadian Gas Utility Services to Canadian Utility Services following its acquisition of Connect Atlantic Utility Services Corporation.
changes.evidence: Canadian Operations was previously known as Canadian Gas Utility Services or "Canadian Gas".

changes.text: The addition of Connect Atlantic Utility Services Corporation in 2025 was the only change in the composition of the Canadian Operations segment.
changes.evidence: The addition of Connect was the only change in the composition of this segment.
